title: Orange County Deputies Shoot Man Fleeing While Carrying a Gun
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Orlando, Florida — On July 5, 2025, at approximately 1 a.m., Orange County Deputies were assisting with a traffic detail near the intersection of Orlando Central Parkway and Presidents Drive when a man ran from Deputies on foot. That man, 18-year-old Giovanny Melendez Torres, was seen by Deputies running while holding a gun. Three Deputies were running after Melendez Torres when Deputy #1 took him to the ground. As Melendez Torres was running, Deputies #2 and #3 saw that he had a gun in his hand and alerted Deputy #1. After Deputy #1 took Melendez Torres to the ground, Melendez Torres was still holding the firearm. Deputy #1 asked, "Is that a gun?" Deputy #2 responded, "Yes," and discharged his service weapon, followed by Deputy #1. After Deputies #1 and #2 discharged their service weapons, Melendez Torres was on the ground, with the gun next to him near the loading dock. Deputies approached, secured the firearm, and began rendering aid. Deputies continued providing medical aid until the arrival of paramedics. Melendez Torres was transported to the hospital in critical condition. Melendez Torres was charged with aggravated assault with a firearm on law enforcement officer. No Deputies or uninvolved members of the public were injured during this incident.
